items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I believe they called, I'm more sure, I know it positively, this fellow is Robert Charles. Oh, yes. And that's been some time back. I think that was about 1900.

ctx.x: Just me and Freddie. Uh-huh. Whatever. Your older sister didn't play anything? My older sister, she never played nothing. She used to be working for Dr. Bartley, a dentist up down there. Well, that's all she ever done. Worked in the dentist place and filled teeth and all that, you know. My father, he was a cook at Fred Boytrand on Dauphin and Canal. That's been, oh, years back when I was a little kid. What was that? Restaurant there? That was a restaurant and a bar. Well, of course, I'll tell you. When I was a…
You would have been about 11 years old.
